permission: Separate explicit scientific chat permission required; this is a technical proposal. No certificate, stored permission text, new grant or authenticity check.

conditions.coefficient_variables: all frames; signed symmetric; no tail preservation equality

mathematics.j_coordinates: x=D*upper(J);diag weights1,off-diagonal sqrt2. All8 frames,80 signed free coordinates. No preserved tail/full tensor equality.
mathematics.PR: 0.5*||g-A(U)D^-1 x||F^2/f* + gamma*(sum sqrt((T_R D^-1 x)^2+epsilon^2)/M*)^2;identity excluded,head unpenalized
mathematics.convexity: Fixed U: PR convex C2, potentially nonunique; RC2 quadratic and strongly convex for alpha>0. No exact numerical optimum certificate.
mathematics.J_PR_solver: SciPy1.14.1 Newton-CG once per fixed-U block in affine invertible z coordinates;x=x0+Wz;callable exact gradient and analytic full Hessian;xtol1e-12,maxiter1000;raw success separate from original-coordinate stationarity
mathematics.J_metric: B=[A_iso/sqrt(f*);sqrt(2gamma)*T_iso/M*];W=V diag(1/max(s,1));ALL directions kept. Same preconditioning structure as v1,explicit coordinates. No ridge in objective/Hessian. Affine residual r=r0+(AW)z,c=c0+(TW)z;Hessian assembled directly from AW/TW including exact smooth curvature.
mathematics.J_RC2_solver: scipy.linalg.lstsq([A_iso/sqrt(f*);sqrt(2alpha/P0)I],[vec(g)/sqrt(f*);0],lapack_driver=gelsd,cond=eps64*max(shape));no normal-equation solve;save full singular diagnostics and check original gradient
mathematics.U: Same right U exp(skew(eta/sqrt2)),fixed J. JAX64 residual r=vec(g_DF-g)/sqrt(f*) and exact forward Jacobian D. Full SVD W=V diag(1/max(s(D0),1));eta=Wz. SciPy least_squares TRF/exact,linear loss,unbounded,ftol=None,xtol1e-14,gtol1e-12,max_nfev25. No penalty in residual because fixed-J penalty is constant;add constant for full F accounting. No implicit differentiation or changing J within U solver.
mathematics.U_stationarity: Recenter eta=0 at actual new U and current post-refit J;norm2 of gradient in Frobenius-isometric skew coordinates,not a possibly singular global exp-chart gradient.

initialization_policy: Two independent algorithm trajectories from same original qualified saved J/U/x0. No old endpoint/LP candidate warm start. Subsequent J blocks use only their own preceding trajectory state.
trajectory: Initial state -> J0 solve -> state0;then up to64(Uk solve -> mandatory Jk solve -> statek). Never stop at a U update with stale J.

qualification.J: gradient infinity in isometric x <=1e-5 with declared engineering margin;unconstrained KKT stationarity. Check independent contraction/adjoint at states.
qualification.U: Frobenius-isometric full local tangent gradient l2 <=1e-5 with margin. Old native gradient infinity recorded but not substituted.
qualification.raw_flags: Solver success/status/nit/nfev/njev/nhev saved separately. Finite precision-loss flag does not establish or refute independently measured stationarity.
qualification.stopping: J independent first order failing ends arm. Both physical criteria MET =>FIRST_ORDER_MET. U TRF status0 is registered finite evaluation limit;other unsuccessful U statuses end after mandatory J refit. Stall3 or64-cycle cap remains UNQUALIFIED. Classify J/U separately;DF separate. Status1/2/3/4 or Newton-CG success is never a physical stationarity certificate.
qualification.no_global_guarantee: No convex suboptimality enclosure,global U optimum or strict CA proof. New endpoint may violate DF budget despite smaller objective.
qualification.precision_note: Affine residuals reduce repeated Ax-g cancellation but are not higher precision;original contraction/adjoint and existing ffsim codec/native diagnostics remain independent gates. No threshold relaxation.

numerical_allowances.monotonicity: Each block/cycle after-before <=value_absolute+value_relative*maxabs(values);record signed changes,never zero-fill them.
numerical_allowances.native_gradient_note: Fixed tiny f* amplifies reconstruction roundoff;this consistency tolerance is separate from first-order thresholds.
numerical_allowances.DF: Original g-corrected kappa and nuclear scalar once;existing sector36 operator norm plus inherited sector_operation_scale_guard8_proposal_v1 <=.00019875 Ha;engineering guard,not rigorous enclosure.
numerical_allowances.first_order_precision: binary64 NumPy/SciPy;JAX x64;no post-result threshold changes
numerical_allowances.coordinate_gradient: Existing gradient_atol1e-8+gradient_rtol1e-7 checks transformed chain rule and independent U residual gradient. Original-coordinate J/U qualification unchanged. Correctness failure stops;no fallback.

comparison: Within-role compare objective,exactlambda,physical J/U stationarity,DF and classical costs to saved joint and saved separated endpoints. Never rank raw PR vsRC2 F. Qualified tail comparison ONLY if both new first-order and DF pass. One-start finite pilot,no equal-effort speedup or global convergence claim.
classical_cost: Save each block rawphysicalx/coordinatez/jac,W or eta,residual/Jacobian/Hessian actual callback counts,solver nfev/njev/nhev,trial objective/eta norm/directional change,physical U gradient before/after J refit,inclusive wall/CPU/resources. U TRF trial list is not accepted-iteration history;SciPy1.14 TRF iteration count unavailable=>null. Raw solver grad is in z;physical gradient is recorded separately.
call_definition: One logical unit per named operation/block,not per internal objective callback. Library iterations/AD calls counted in block diagnostics. No entire multi-block trajectory hidden as one solve.
cap_derivation: Each arm65 J+64 U+66 states+7(load/setup/initial/history/terminal/tensor/export)=202;two arms404+parent11=415. Entire trajectory not hidden as one solve. No units transferred from old run.
execution_order: load original qualified packet/J/U/x0 and saved initial DF qualification;physical sector once
independent PR/RC2 roles;reuse pinned old scalar histories without new old-point evaluation
initial J then at most64(fixed-J U residual TRF ->mandatory J solve->original physical stationarity);count all blocks
parent:new final DF norm/guard and sector CAR/generalK for each role
within-objective old/new comparison;separate first-order,DF and tail qualification;publish thenmandatory STOP
outputs: diagnostic native x/jac (not fake global optimizer output)
initial/final objective,tensor metrics and independent terminal validation
saved joint and saved separated scalar references
all-direction SVD scales and exact-Hessian callback counts
TRF trial vs endpoint distinction;U physical gradient before and after J refit

STOP.correctness: SOURCE/input/shape/finite/gradient-coordinate/value/orthogonality/nonincrease/representation mismatch =>STOP dependent work;preserve raw endpoints and partial. No old run resumed;drain started independent worker with fixed scope.
STOP.unqualified: Finite block/outer limit/stall first-order failure exported and DF-assessed as UNQUALIFIED;no retry,initial fallback,new start or solver switch.
STOP.budget: DF NOT_MET separately;no strength/rank/scale changes or automatic candidate acceptance.
STOP.completion: Commit,push,remote SHA/tree/source/raw checks then mandatorySTOP;no downstream scientific stage.

exclusions: actual science without separate explicit permission
U reinitialization,polar or new gauge operation
saved_history_policy: Read pinned JSON scalar histories once per role. No old joint/separated NPZ loads,new old-point metric evaluations or old optimization. Same physical J/U metric was already computed in prior417 contract. New-vs-old comparisons reuse these saved scalar values only.
known_limitations: Artificial small-loss-scale controls show greatly lower fixed-J U residual gradient yet post-J-refit U gradient rebound and64-cycle joint UNQUALIFIED for both objectives. This proposal tests real-data applicability;does not assume full convergence will improve. Newton-CG can still return line-search warning with independently MET J residual. No new H4 Hessian scan/FD or option search beyond required solver internals.
